scope: Unique primary sources supplementing researcher/verifier records; metadata/read scope distinguished from inferred overlap. No experiments run.

sources.title: SA-TTS: Stress-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Vision Models
sources.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops, pages 11480–11487
sources.publicationstatus: CVPR 2026 workshop proceedings; primary CVF metadata verified
sources.read_scope: CVF metadata/abstract and indexed first-page method/Algorithm 1; direct PDF access initially blocked for reviewer. Lead subsequently downloaded a local source copy.
sources.method_overlap: Staged acquisition: entropy/margin first, augmentation disagreement when needed, then multi-crop inference. Blocks a generic novelty claim about escalating evidence on uncertain inputs.
sources.limitation: Inspected terminal actions are inference policies with a fixed backbone rather than selection among parameter-update TTA methods. Detailed experiments were not audited by reviewer.

sources.title: FORGE: Forward-Only Test-Time Adaptation for Integer-Only Vision Models on Microcontrollers
sources.venue: arXiv:2609.01683v1; arXiv record identifies Transactions on Machine Learning Research 2026 publication
sources.publicationstatus: Preprint submitted 1 September 2026; TMLR venue claim present on primary author record, but acceptance independently unverified by reviewer
sources.read_scope: Abstract/metadata, full HTML section 4.6, Algorithm 2 and section 5 limitations; selected deployment text inspected
sources.method_overlap: Runs source and adapted paths during a short unlabeled calibration window, charges duplicate forward passes, then commits using confidence improvement. Paid probing and no-update fallback are prior art.
sources.limitation: Reported confidence gate loses useful adaptation under many-class overconfidence; source statistics and BN-folded convolutional deployment requirements differ from generic backbones. Its result is not a universal safety guarantee.

sources.title: BoTTA: Benchmarking On-device Test Time Adaptation
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 2026 ACM/IEEE International Conference on Embedded Artificial Intelligence and Sensing Systems, pages 465–477
sources.publicationstatus: Publisher full text identifies SenSys 2026, published 10 May 2026; older arXiv:2504.10149v2 record instead carries a SenSys 2025 report-number statement. Preserve this discrepancy; publisher version is used for conference citation.
sources.read_scope: Publisher metadata/abstract, sections 2 and 4, system metric descriptions and conclusion; preprint metadata checked separately
sources.method_overlap: Limited target data, incomplete category coverage, overlapping shifts and hardware-constrained periodic adaptation are already benchmarked.
sources.limitation: This is an evaluation framework, not the proposed learned multi-action acquisition policy. Paper-linked code URL https://github.com/m-danilow/BoTTA returned 404 in this review, so availability is not established.

sources.title: When Does Test-Time Physical Diagnosis Pay? A Frozen Policy Buys Evidence It Never Reads
sources.read_scope: Primary metadata, abstract and introduction; full experiments not audited
sources.method_overlap: Separates identifying context, using acquired evidence, decision value, selection value over a fixed action and safe realization. Supports distinct headroom/evidence-use diagnostics.
sources.limitation: Robotics rather than visual-classification TTA; cannot be treated as a matched numerical baseline or proof that the candidate is novel.

sources.venue: arXiv:2609.08367v1; author record comments identify ECCV 2026

sources.method_overlap: Cross-Augmentation Similarity decides whether to perform or skip a VLM adaptation, directly overlapping extra-view evidence for an update/no-update decision.
sources.limitation: The candidate needs multi-action value-based evidence acquisition beyond this fixed view-based skip rule. Adaptation skipping is not itself new.
